name: mf-generate-image-v1
_comment: OPTIONAL / EXAMPLE — illustrates the webhook→work→respond pattern for fal.ai image calls. Not required for MVP. The primary image generation path is via the worker's generate-image BullMQ queue and the ImageAdapter (ADR-007). Use this n8n workflow only if you want to offload fal polling to n8n's queue-mode executors instead of the worker.

parameters.jsCode:
const err = $input.first().json?.error ?? $input.first().json?.message ?? 'Unknown image-gen error';
return [{ json: { images: [], _error: String(err) } }];
